_comment: A numeric-keypad layout for the virtual RHC and THC, in the spirit of the keypad RCS keys of other orbiter simulators (check against your own habit and edit). Rotation on the keypad; translation on the arrow keys and Page Up/Down. Use with --keys examples/keys-keypad.json, or put this "keys" object in ~/.config/nsts/joysticks.json. Names are pygame's: [4] is keypad 4. Unnamed actions keep the defaults.
